blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We study how vision-language models (VLMs) can learn to think and actively explore in 3D space. Instead of providing multi-view images, videos, or 3D representations to the model, we preserve the native visual encoding of VLMs, i.e., a single image, one at a time, just like humans, and treat the 3D representation only as an environment with which the model can interact through actions (e.g., move left) and observations (rendered images). Each rollout begins from an initial first-person view and a visual question. The model can then iteratively reason, navigate, and reorient its viewpoint before committing to a final answer. Following an initial trajectory-supervised finetuning, we apply reinforcement learning (RL) with rewards driven primarily by final-answer correctness. Crucially, RL provides no direct supervision over which viewpoints the model should visit or which exploration actions it should take. Instead, the model must learn an effective exploration policy solely from the extent to which its interactions improve performance. Across six 3D benchmarks, our model ACT3D achieves an average accuracy of 53.2% that improves its base Qwen model by 22.0% and surpasses proprietary Gemini 3.6 Flash. ACT3D also outperforms existing open-source 3D methods while using 50-70% fewer input frames, and generalizes to unseen domains with an average improvement of 5.9% over its supervised initialization. Further analysis reveals adaptive, question-conditioned exploration. Performance gains over the base model increase from 0.6% on questions answerable from the initial view to 16.3% on those requiring extensive exploration. ACT3D searches for occluded targets, avoids unnecessary exploration, and acquires complementary viewpoints for spatial comparisons. These findings demonstrate that outcome-based RL enables VLMs not only to reason over visual evidence, but also to learn when and how to acquire it.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Despite substantial progress in 3D vision-language models, much of the existing work studies spatial reasoning under observations that are specified a priori , providing models with complete RGB-D scans ( Azuma et al., 2022 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) , multi-view images ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , videos ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) , or explicit 3D scene representations such as point clouds and meshes ( Hong et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024b ) .
Yet under partial observability, a fundamental challenge remains: the model must not only reason over the evidence currently available, but also determine how to act in order to acquire the evidence that is missing. This motivates the central question of our work: can a vision-language model learn to actively explore and acquire task-relevant visual evidence as an integral part of the 3D reasoning process?
blocks.zh:
尽管在3D视觉语言模型上取得了很大进展,但许多现有的工作研究是在预先指定的观测下进行空间推理,为模型提供完整的RGB-D扫描(Azuma等人,2022年;Zhu等人,2025年),多视图图像(Yang等人,2025年),视频(郑等人,2025年;Yang等人,2026年a年),或点云和 meshes等明显的3D场景表现(Hong等人,2023年;Huang等人,2024年b年).
然而,在部分可观察性的情况下,一个根本挑战依然存在:这一模式不仅必须说明现有证据的理由,而且还必须确定如何采取行动以获取缺失的证据。 这激发了我们工作的中心问题:一个视觉语言模型能否学习积极探索和获取与任务相关的视觉证据,作为3D推理过程的一个组成部分?

blocks.en:
We address this question by first formulating reasoning in 3D as an interactive visual decision process under partial observability. Rather than providing the VLM with a complete 3D representation, the 3D scene is kept external to the VLM and serves as an interactive environment that the model accesses through sequential action-observation interactions. Starting from a fixed initial egocentric view and a visual question, the model alternates between reasoning and interaction, iteratively acquiring observations through navigation and viewpoint control before committing to a final answer. This entire episode of interaction constitutes a policy rollout, in which the model jointly determines what information to acquire, how to interact with the environment, and how to reason over the accumulated evidence .
To learn a policy that integrates visual information acquisition, spatial interaction, and reasoning, we adopt a two-stage training procedure: trajectory-supervised fine-tuning first establishes the interaction protocol, after which reinforcement learning optimizes the full interactive policy over the rollout described above using rewards driven primarily by final-answer correctness. During reinforcement learning, no direct supervision is provided for intermediate viewpoints, actions, or exploration trajectories. Effective exploration must instead be learned through credit assignment from task performance. This formulation enables us to examine whether task-level supervision alone can induce task-directed visual information acquisition during 3D reasoning.
blocks.zh:
我们对这一问题的处理首先在3D中提出推理,作为部分可观察性的交互式视觉决定程序。 3D场景不是向VLM提供完整的3D代表,而是保留在VLM的外部,成为模型通过相继的动作-观察互动访问的互动环境. 从固定的初始自我中心观点和视觉问题开始,模型在推理和互动之间替代,通过导航和视角控制反复获取观测结果,然后承诺做出最后的回答. 整个互动集构成政策推展,其中模式共同决定获取何种信息、如何与环境互动以及如何对所积累的证据进行推理。
为了学习一个将视觉信息获取,空间互动,推理相结合的政策,我们采取了一个两阶段的训练程序:由轨迹监督的微调首先建立互动协议,之后强化学习利用主要由最终答案正确性驱动的奖励,将全面互动政策优化于上述推出. 在强化学习期间,没有直接监督中间观点、行动或勘探轨迹。 相反,必须通过任务执行中的信用分配来学习有效的探索。 这种提法使我们能够审查单靠任务一级的监督能否在三维推理过程中诱导任务导向的视觉信息的获取.

blocks.en:
Building on this formulation, we present Act3D, a vision-language model that jointly learns to acquire visual evidence and reason over observations. Experiments across six 3D benchmarks show that Act3D achieves an average accuracy of 53.2%, outperforming all evaluated prior methods and baselines. It improves upon its base Qwen model by 22.0% and surpasses Gemini 3.6 Flash by 1.0%. Act3D also outperforms existing open-source 3D methods while using 50–70% fewer input frames and lower-resolution observations. These gains generalize to out-of-distribution beyond the training domains, with an average improvement of 5.9% over the supervised initialization across four out-of-domain benchmarks. Beyond accuracy, we observe the emergence of adaptive exploration behaviors where models learn to explore more with increasing interaction steps on questions that require more exploration, leading to pronounced improvements when target objects are initially occluded or far away from the initial camera position. We further qualitatively illustrate that Act3D learns to search for hidden objects, limit unnecessary exploration when relevant evidence is already visible, and gather complementary viewpoints to resolve spatial relationships.
Together, these findings demonstrate that RL enables VLMs not only to reason over visual observations, but also to adaptively acquire the evidence needed for 3D reasoning.
blocks.zh:
基于这一提法,我们提出Act3D,这是一种视觉语言模式,通过观察共同学习获取视觉证据和理性。 6个立体化基准的实验表明,Act3D的平均精度达到53.2%,超过了所有被评价的先前方法和基线。 它的基座Quen模型改进了22.0%,超过双子座3.6 Flash1. Act3D还超越了现有的开源三维方法,同时使用50–70%的减量输入帧和低分辨率观测. 这些收益被概括到培训领域以外的分配之外,平均比四个领域以外基准的监督初始化提高5.9%。 除了准确性外,我们观察到适应性探索行为的出现,即模型在需要更多探索的问题上学习用越来越多的互动步骤进行更多探索,从而在目标物体最初被占据或远离初始相机位置时导致显著的改进. 我们进一步从质量上说明,Act3D学会了寻找隐藏的物体,在相关证据已经可见时限制不必要的探索,并收集补充观点以解决空间关系.
这些调查结果表明,RL不仅使VLMs在视觉观测上能够理性,而且能够适应性地获取3D推理所需的证据.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Prior work on 3D vision-language models operates over observations assumed to be complete and directly presented to the model, including 3D representations such as point clouds and object-centric features ( Hong et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024a ; Huang et al., 2024b ; Jin et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024c ; Kang et al., 2025 ) , fixed multi-view images or videos ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Qi et al., 2025 ) , and representations enhanced through reconstruction supervision ( Wang et al., 2025a ) .
A parallel line of work improves spatial reasoning in general-purpose VLMs through large-scale spatial supervision ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Yang et al., 2026a ) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) .
Despite advances in spatial reasoning, these approaches largely assume that the visual evidence required to answer a question is provided to the model, rather than actively acquired during inference.
In contrast, Act3D keeps the 3D scene representation external to the VLM as an interactive environment: the model receives only egocentric 2D observations and learns to navigate and acquire task-relevant visual evidence through interaction, jointly with reasoning.
blocks.zh:
3D视觉语言模型的前期工作在假定是完整的观测之上进行,并直接提交给模型,包括点云和以物体为中心的特征等3D表示(Hong等人,2023年;Huang等人,2024年a; Huang等, 2024b; Jin等, 2023; Zhu等. ; 2023; Chen等人, 2024b; Fu等人, 2025; Zhu等人, 2024; Chen等人, 2024c; Kang等人, 2025),固定的多视图图像或视频(Zhu等人, 2025年; Zheng等人, 2025年; Qi等人, 2025年),并通过重建监督加强陈述(Wang等人, 2025a).
平行的工作线通过大规模空间监督改进了通用甚高频的空间推理(Chen等人,2024a); Yang等人,2026a)和可核查奖励的强化学习(Oyang等人,2025;Wu等人,2026;Li等人,2026a).
尽管在空间推理方面取得了进展,但这些方法基本上假定回答一个问题所需的视觉证据是提供给模型的,而不是在推论中积极获得的.
相比之下,Act3D将3D场景表现保留在VLM外部作为互动环境:该模型只接收以自我为中心的2D观测,并学习通过互动,与推理联合导航和获取与任务相关的视觉证据.

blocks.en: Multimodal agentic reasoning.
blocks.zh: 多式联运代理推理.

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning (RL) (e.g., GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) ) has emerged as an effective paradigm for improving reasoning capabilities ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026c ) . It has further been applied to agentic systems with multi-turn interaction and tool use ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026d ; Wang et al., 2025c ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) , as well as to multimodal reasoning ( Feng et al., 2025a ; Feng et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2025 ) .
These methods primarily manipulate or revisit visual evidence already contained in the provided input. In contrast, our model learns to explore the 3D environment, actively acquiring new visual evidence while jointly optimizing reasoning and interaction in a single rollout.

加强学习(RL)(例如,GRPO(Shao等人,2024年;Wang等人,2026年b))已成为提高推理能力的有效范例(Guo等人,2025年;Yang等人,2026年b); Yu等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2026年b;Li等人,2026年c). 它被进一步应用于具有多转动相互作用和使用工具的代理系统(Jiang等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年d; Wang等人,2025c;Jin等人,2025c;Luo等人,2025),以及多式联运推理(Feng等人,2025a;Feng等人,2025b;Li等人,2026b;Li等人,2024;Huang等人,2026;Liu等人,2025;Shen等人,2025).
这些方法主要操控或重新审视已经包含在所提供的投入中的视觉证据。 相比之下,我们的模型学习探索3D环境,积极获取新的视觉证据,同时在一次推出中共同优化推理和互动.

blocks.en:
Exploration in embodied and 3D environments. EmbodiedQA introduced navigation-based question answering ( Das et al., 2017 ) , later extended to open-vocabulary evaluation by OpenEQA ( Majumdar et al., 2024 ) .
Recent benchmarks further show that active observation can outperform passive viewing and expose failures in spatial exploration and long-horizon planning ( Hong et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Wei et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . We abstract embodiment to direct camera control over a scanned 3D scene and jointly learn exploration and reasoning for question answering.
More closely related are methods that actively select viewpoints. Chain-of-View performs training-free coarse-to-fine view selection through a discrete camera-action interface ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) . Think3D equips models with 3D reconstruction tools and optimizes their use with RL ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . ViewSuite distills self-exploration into a view graph ( Wang et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh:
在内在和三维环境中进行探索。 EmformQA引入了基于导航的问答(Das等人,2017年),后来扩展为OpenEQA的开放-vobulary评价(Majumdar等人,2024年).
近期的基准进一步表明,主动观测可以超越被动观测,暴露空间探索和长视距规划的失败(Hong等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年c;Zhang等人,2026年a;Wei等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年a). 我们抽象地将摄像头控制在扫描的三维场景上 共同学习解答问题的探索和推理

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We study how a VLM can learn to reason in 3D under partial observability.
Learning such a policy poses two complementary challenges.
The model must first acquire a basic interaction competence in 3D environments before it can learn from the interaction with environments despite the absence of ground-truth exploration trajectories.
We therefore adopt a two-stage training procedure. We first perform trajectory-supervised fine-tuning using curated interaction demonstrations to initialize a coherent reason–act–observe policy. We then apply reinforcement learning with verifiable reward to optimize the policy with rewards driven only by final performance, without supervision of any intermediate viewpoints or actions. This allows the model to learn task-directed exploration end-to-end, supervised only by how much the evidence it acquires improves its answers.
blocks.zh:
我们研究一个VLM如何在部分可观察性下在3D中学习理性.
学习这种政策是两个相辅相成的挑战。
该模型必须首先在三维环境中获得基本的交互能力,然后才能在缺乏地面-真实探索轨迹的情况下,从环境的互动中学习。
因此,我们采用两阶段培训程序。 首先,我们通过精心设计的互动示范来进行轨迹监督的微调,以启动连贯的理由-行为-观察政策。 然后,我们用可核查的奖励进行强化学习,以优化政策,其奖励只受最后业绩的驱动,而不监督任何中间观点或行动。 这使得模型可以学习以任务为方向的勘探端到端,仅由其获得的证据能在多大程度上改进答案来监督.

We adopt the relative parameterization throughout training and evaluation. Absolute actions require
the policy to predict coordinates in a global reference frame that is not directly observed and whose
scale varies across scenes. In contrast, relative actions are scale-invariant, camera-centric, and
map naturally to interpretable motions such as “move left” or “turn right”. We compare the two
parameterizations empirically in Appendix 4.6 .

blocks.en:
All experiments use Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) as the base model. We consider two training configurations: ScanQA-only and mixed-data.
In the ScanQA-only setting, SFT uses 2,550 teacher trajectories, followed by GRPO on 25,563 ScanQA questions. In the mixed-data setting, SFT uses 5,712 trajectories from ScanQA ( Azuma et al., 2022 ) , MP3D ( Chang et al., 2017 ) , and ESI ( Hong et al., 2026 ) , while GRPO is performed on 51,543 questions from ScanQA, MP3D, and curated QA data from ScanNet and ARKitScenes ( Baruch et al., 2021 ) . Both settings follow the same two-stage training procedure, and we evaluate base model, SFT initialization, and RL-trained policy to isolate the contribution of each training stage.

blocks.en: Evaluation. We evaluate all models under a unified interactive protocol. Each model is initialized with a single 640 × 480 640\times 480 render of the scene and is allowed up to twelve interactions to acquire additional observations; all active baselines are evaluated using the same interaction harness and budget. We use Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) as the answer judge throughout evaluation. We evaluate on six benchmarks spanning diverse indoor environments and spatial reasoning settings: SPBench-SI and SPBench-MV ( Li et al., 2026a ) , ARKitScenes ( Baruch et al., 2021 ) , ScanQA ( Azuma et al., 2022 ) , SQA3D ( Ma et al., 2023 ) , and MP3D ( Chang et al., 2017 ) . Together, these benchmarks cover settings ranging from single-room visual question answering to multi-scene spatial reasoning.

blocks.en: We compare Act3D with a broad range of existing 3D reasoning methods and general-purpose VLMs. For passive perception, we include Video-R1 ( Feng et al., 2025a ) , ViLaSR ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , SpatialLadder ( Li et al., 2026a ) , SpaceR ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) , and Ross3D ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , alongside InternVL3.5-38B ( Wang et al., 2025b ) evaluated with fixed visual observations. For active interaction, we evaluate open-source VLMs, including Qwen2.5-VL-72B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , Qwen3.5-9B/27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , and InternVL3.5-38B, as well as the proprietary Gemini 3.6 Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) . These models are evaluated under the same observation–action interface and interaction budget, whereas passive methods retain their respective input and inference protocols. We additionally report the base model and SFT checkpoints to isolate the contributions of different training stages.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1: Performance comparison on six 3D reasoning benchmarks. We compare Act3D with existing active and passive methods. Green highlights indicate benchmark domains included in model training.
blocks.zh: 表1:六个立体推理基准的业绩比较。 我们比较Act3D与现有的主动和被动方法. 绿色重点说明列入示范培训的基准领域。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , Act3D trained on mixed data achieves the highest average accuracy of 53.2% across six benchmarks, surpassing the Qwen3.5-9B base model by 22.0%. It further outperforms Gemini 3.6 Flash by 1.0% under the same interaction protocol, as well as all evaluated open-source 3D reasoning methods, including both active interaction and passive perception approaches. Notably, Act3D achieves these results from a single initial view, autonomously acquiring additional visual evidence through interaction with the environment.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,通过混合数据培训的Act3D在六个基准中的平均准确度最高,为53.2%,比Quen3.5-9B基准模型高出22.0%。 它在相同的交互协议下进一步超越双子座3.6 Flash1.0%,以及所有被评价的开源3D推理方法,包括主动交互和被动感知方法. 值得注意的是,Act3D通过单一的初始视角,通过与环境的互动,自主获取更多的视觉证据,实现了这些结果.

blocks.en: RL substantially improves over SFT initialization. In the mixed-data setting, RL improves average accuracy from 48.6% to 53.2% (+4.6%) over the SFT init, with improvements on five of six benchmarks. The largest gains occur on ARKit (+14.1%) and SPBench-MV (+8.1%), highlighting the benefits of optimizing exploration and reasoning through verifiable RL beyond supervised trajectory imitation.
blocks.zh: 与SFT初始化相比,RL有很大改进. 在混合数据设置中,RL比SFT输入器提高了平均精度,从48.6%提高到53.2%(+4.6%),6个基准中的5个基准有所改进。 最大的收益出现在ARKit(+14.1%)和SP Bench-MV(+8.1%)上,这突出表明了通过超出受监督轨迹仿制的可核查RL优化勘探和推理的好处。

Despite using a single training set for RL optimization, Act3D improves average accuracy from 47.8% to 50.6% (+2.8%) over its SFT initialization and extends its improvement beyond ScanQA (+6.1%), with average accuracy across the other five benchmarks increasing from 49.5% to 51.6% (+2.1%). blocks.en: 4.3 Learning Dynamics and Exploration Behavior
blocks.zh: 4.3 学习动态和探索行为

blocks.en: RL improves reasoning performance while reshaping interaction behavior. Figure 4 illustrates the evolution of performance and interaction behavior during RL training. In the ScanQA-only setting, validation accuracy improves from 40.2% to 45.5% (Figure 4 (a)). Mixed-data training similarly yields improvements across all three validation benchmarks, with the largest gains on ARKitScenes (Figure 4 (b)). Meanwhile, the average number of interactions per episode increases from approximately 3.3 to 8.3 during mixed-data training (Figure 4 (c)), indicating that RL optimization progressively encourages more extensive interaction with the environment. These observations motivate a closer examination of how exploration contributes to reasoning performance.
blocks.zh: RL在重塑交互行为的同时,提高了推理性能. 图4说明了RL训练期间表现和互动行为的演变. 在ScanQA唯一的设定中,验证精度从40.2%提高到45.5%(图4(a))。 混合数据培训同样改善了所有三项验证基准,在ARKitScenes(图4(b))。 同时,在混合数据培训期间,每集的平均互动次数从大约3.3次增加到8.3次(图4(c)),这表明RL优化逐步鼓励与环境进行更广泛的互动。 这些观察促使人们更仔细地审查勘探如何有助于推理性能。

blocks.en: Adaptive Exploration Behavior. To investigate how performance gains depend on the need for exploration, we stratify ScanQA validation questions by their estimated exploration demand (Figure 5 ). Specifically, we estimate the number of actions needed to approach the annotated answer object based on its bearing and distance from the initial viewpoint. This geometry-based measure is independent of the model’s actual interaction behavior. We find that the combined improvements from SFT and RL are generally larger for questions requiring more exploration, increasing from 0.6% in the lowest-demand group to 16.3% in the highest. Notably, RL contributes an additional 10.9% over SFT in the most demanding group. These findings suggest that the benefits of outcome-based RL are particularly pronounced when solving a question requires acquiring visual evidence beyond the initial observation.
blocks.zh: 适应性探索行为. 为了调查性能收益如何取决于勘探的需要,我们对ScanQA验证问题按其估计的勘探需求进行分类(图5)。 具体地说,我们根据附加说明的回答对象的影响和与最初观点的距离,估计了处理该回答对象所需的行动数量。 这种基于几何学的测量独立于模型的实际交互行为. 我们发现,SFT和RL的合并改进对于需要更多探索的问题来说一般更大,从需求最低的组群的0.6%上升到需求最高的16.3%。 值得注意的是,在要求最高的群体中,再增加10.9%。 这些调查结果表明,在解决一个问题需要获取初步观察以外的视觉证据时,基于结果的RL的好处特别明显。

blocks.en: 4.4 Qualitative Analysis.
blocks.zh: 4.4 定性分析。

blocks.en: Figure 6 illustrates several exploration strategies that emerge from Act3D’s training. When relevant objects are initially occluded or outside the field of view, the policy actively changes its viewpoint to locate them before answering. When the target is already visible, it performs brief verification with minimal additional interaction. For questions requiring spatial comparisons or relationships between multiple objects, the policy explores complementary viewpoints to gather sufficient evidence. Notably, its reasoning evolves as new observations become available, allowing it to refine initial hypotheses and resolve ambiguities through successive interactions. These examples illustrate how Act3D integrates visual evidence acquisition with reasoning in a question-dependent manner.
blocks.zh: 图6说明了Act3D培训中出现的若干探索战略。 当相关对象最初被占据或者处于视野之外时,政策会积极改变观点,在回答之前先找到它们的位置. 当目标已经可见时,它将进行简短的核查,尽量减少额外的互动。 对于需要多个物体间空间比较或关系的问题,政策探索互补的观点,以收集足够的证据. 值得注意的是,它的推理随着新的观察结果的出现而演变,使其得以通过连续的相互作用来完善初步的假设和解决模棱两可的问题。 这些例子说明Act3D如何将视觉证据的获取与推理以依问题而定的方式整合.

blocks.zh: 4.5 结果

blocks.en: 4.5.1 Initial Observation
blocks.zh: 4.5.1 初步意见

blocks.en: We investigate how the initial visual input affects interactive reasoning performance (Table 2 ). Starting from a single rendered view achieves 41.0% accuracy on ScanQA, closely matching the 41.4% obtained with a bird’s-eye view (BEV) and four rendered views, despite using only one initial image instead of five. In contrast, combining a BEV with a single rendered view reduces accuracy to 36.7%. These results suggest that additional initial visual context does not necessarily improve performance. We therefore adopt single-view initialization, which preserves the partial observability of the task while achieving comparable accuracy with substantially less visual input.
blocks.zh: 我们调查最初的视觉输入如何影响交互推理性能(表2). 从单一渲染的视图开始,ScanQA的精度达到了41.0%,与鸟眼视图(BEV)和四张视图紧密匹配,尽管只使用了一张初始图像而不是五张。 相比之下,将BEV与单一渲染的视图相结合,精确度降至36.7%。 这些结果表明,额外的初始视觉环境并不一定能改善性能. 因此,我们采用单视图初始化,这保留了任务的部分可观察性,同时以视觉输入少得多的方式实现可比较的准确性。

blocks.en: 4.5.2 Observation Interface: Rendering vs. Retrieval
blocks.zh: 4.5.2 观察接口:渲染与检索

blocks.en: Act3D formulates 3D reasoning as interaction with a 3D scene representation, making the design of the visual observation interface an important consideration. Rendered observations can be generated at arbitrary camera poses but may suffer from limited visual fidelity, whereas real images preserve greater visual detail but are restricted to the viewpoints captured during data collection. We examine this trade-off by comparing pose-aligned rendering with nearest-view retrieval of real ScanNet images. As illustrated in Figure 7 , retrieved images can deviate substantially from the requested camera poses, introducing inconsistencies between executed actions and subsequent observations. Under matched training conditions, rendering consistently outperforms real-image retrieval across all 13 evaluation checkpoints, achieving 10.6% higher accuracy on average. These results highlight the importance of action–observation consistency in interactive 3D reasoning, even at the expense of visual fidelity.
blocks.zh: Act3D将3D推理表述为与3D场景代表的交互,使得视觉观测界面的设计成为一个重要的考虑因素. 成像观测可以在任意的相机姿势下产生,但可能受视觉忠贞度有限的影响,而真实的图像则保存了更多的视觉细节,但仅限于在数据收集过程中获取的观点。 我们通过比较姿势对齐的渲染 和最近的ScanNet图像检索 来检查这种权衡 如图7所示,检索的图像可大大偏离所要求的相机外观,造成已执行的行动与随后的观察不一致。 在相应的培训条件下,所有13个评价检查站的实景检索率始终高于实景检索率,平均达到10.6%的准确率。 这些结果凸显了动作-观察一致性在交互式3D推理中的重要性,即使牺牲视觉上的忠诚。

blocks.en: Figure 8: ScanQA Acc. of different action parameterizations.
blocks.zh: 图8:扫描QA 不同动作参数化的 Acc.

blocks.en: 4.6 Action Space
blocks.zh: 4.6 行动空间

blocks.en: We investigate the effect of action parameterization by comparing relative camera movements with direct prediction of absolute camera poses. As shown in Figure 8 , relative actions achieve 41.4% accuracy on ScanQA, compared with 36.7% for absolute pose prediction. Unlike absolute coordinates, which require reasoning in a scene-dependent global reference frame, relative actions operate in the camera’s local coordinate system and correspond to intuitive movements such as translation and rotation. This representation aligns more naturally with sequential, observation-conditioned exploration, motivating its adoption throughout Act3D.
blocks.zh: 我们通过比较相对相机运动和直接预测绝对相机姿势来调查动作参数化的效果. 如图8所示,ScanQA的相对动作精度为41.4%,绝对姿势预测为36.7%。 与绝对坐标不同,绝对坐标需要在基于场景的全球参考框架进行推理,相对动作在相机的局部坐标系统中运行,并对应翻译和旋转等直观运动. 这一表述更自然地与有观察条件的相继探索保持一致,促使在整个第3D号法案中予以通过。

blocks.en: 4.7 Supervised initialization
blocks.zh: 4.7 监督初始化

blocks.en: We investigate the role of supervised initialization in learning interactive reasoning behaviors (Figure 9 ). Without SFT, direct RL improves ScanQA accuracy from 28.9% to 34.8–37.9% after 80 training steps, although the policy performs only approximately one interaction per episode. Extending training to 470 steps further improves accuracy to 41.4%, with the average number of interactions increasing to 2.0. These results suggest that RL alone can gradually improve reasoning performance while developing interaction capabilities. In contrast, SFT-initialized RL improves accuracy from 39.5% to 42.7%, accompanied by an increase in average number of interactions from 2.7 to 8.7 per episode. A possible explanation is that the base model is not initially adapted to the interactive environment and action protocol, whereas supervised trajectory initialization enables the model to acquire basic interaction capabilities before RL optimization. Although the settings differ in backbone and training budget, these findings suggest that SFT facilitates adaptation to the interactive setting and may accelerate subsequent RL optimization, rather than being strictly necessary for learning to interact.
blocks.zh: 我们调查监督初始化在学习互动推理行为中的作用(图9). 没有SFT,直接RL在80个训练步骤后将ScanQA的精度从28.9%提高到34.8–37.9%,尽管政策每集只进行大约一次互动. 将培训范围扩大到470个步骤,将准确度进一步提高到41.4%,平均互动次数增至2.0。 这些结果表明,单靠RL可以逐步提高推理性能,同时发展互动能力. 相比之下,SFT初始化的RL的精度从39.5%提高到42.7%,同时每集的平均交互次数也从2.7增加到8.7. 一个可能的解释是,基础模型最初并不适应交互环境和动作协议,而受监督的轨迹初始化使得模型在RL优化前获得基本的交互能力. 虽然在骨干和培训预算方面的设置不同,但这些结论表明,SFT有助于适应互动环境,并可能加快随后的RL优化,而不是学习互动的绝对必要.

blocks.en: 4.8 Interaction Reward
blocks.zh: 4.8 互动奖励

blocks.en: Figure 10: Effect of interaction reward. ScanQA Acc. with and without the per-interaction reward across held-out and training benchmarks. Numbers below the bars indicate the average number of interactions per episode.
blocks.zh: 图10:互动奖励的效果。 ScanQA Acc. 包括或不包含跨暂停和培训基准的每次互动奖励。 列下的数字表示每集的平均交互次数.

blocks.en: Explicitly rewarding interactions substantially increases exploration frequency, but does not uniformly improve reasoning accuracy (Figure 10 ). Adding a reward of 0.05 per interaction increases the average number of interactions from 5.1–6.3 to 9.4–10.1 per episode across six benchmarks. While this reward improves accuracy on all three held-out benchmarks, particularly SPBench-MV (+6.4%), it slightly reduces performance on the training domains (0.3–2.3%). These results suggest that encouraging additional interactions can benefit cross-domain generalization, although more extensive exploration does not necessarily yield higher accuracy. The interaction reward therefore serves primarily to encourage active evidence acquisition, while outcome-based feedback guides the policy toward effective reasoning.
blocks.zh: 明确奖励的相互作用大大增加了勘探频率,但并没有统一提高推理的准确性(图10)。 加上每次互动0.05的奖励,将平均互动次数从每集5.1至6.3增至9.4至10.1,分为6个基准。 虽然这项奖励提高了所有三项搁置基准的准确性,特别是SP Bench-MV(+6.4%),但略微降低了培训领域的业绩(0.3-2.3%)。 这些结果表明,鼓励更多的互动有助于跨域的泛化,尽管更广泛的探索不一定产生更高的准确性。 因此,互动奖励主要有助于鼓励积极获取证据,而基于成果的反馈则指导政策有效推理。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented Act3D, a framework for learning to think and explore in the 3D world by treating 3D representations as interactive environments rather than assumed complete inputs. Starting from a single observation, Act3D iteratively reasons, acts, and acquires visual evidence through interaction with the environment. Building on supervised trajectory initialization, verifiable RL further optimizes the policy without explicit supervision of exploration actions or viewpoints. Across six 3D benchmarks, Act3D achieves the highest average accuracy of 53.2%, improving upon its SFT initialization by 4.6% and outperforming existing active and passive 3D reasoning methods. Further analyses show that these gains extend beyond the training benchmark and are particularly pronounced on questions requiring more extensive exploration. Qualitative results also reveal question-conditioned exploration strategies that adapt to newly acquired observations. Together, these findings demonstrate the potential of outcome-based RL to learn not only how to reason over visual evidence, but also how to actively acquire the evidence needed for 3D reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Act3D,这是一个学习在3D世界中思考和探索的框架,将3D代表作为互动环境,而不是假设完整的投入. 从一个单一的观察开始,Act3D通过与环境的相互作用,迭代的原因,行为和获取视觉证据. 在监督轨道初始化的基础上,可核查的RL在没有明确监督勘探行动或观点的情况下,进一步优化了政策。 在6个3D基准中,Act3D实现了53.2%的最高平均精度,在SFT初始化后提高了4.6%,并且超过了现有的主动和被动3D推理方法。 进一步的分析表明,这些收益超出了培训基准,在需要更广泛探索的问题上尤为突出。 定性结果还揭示了适应新获得的观测结果的附有问题条件的勘探战略。 这些调查结果表明,基于结果的RL不仅可以学习如何比视觉证据更理智,而且可以学习如何积极获取3D推理所需的证据。
